text:
Predicates:
British(x) ::: x is British.
Sitcom(x) ::: x is a sitcom series.
Starring(x, y) ::: x is starring members of y.
Piloted(x, y) ::: x piloted in year y.
WorkingTitle(x, y) ::: x has the working title y.
ScriptEditor(x, y) ::: x is the script editor for y.
Premises:
British(badults) ∧ Sitcom(badults) ∧ Starring(badults, pappys) ::: Badults is a British Sitcom series, starring members of Pappy's.
Piloted(badults, year2013) ∧ Piloted(badults, bbcThree) ::: Badults piloted in July 2013 on BBC Three.
WorkingTitle(badults, secretDudeSociety) ::: The Working title "The Secret Dude Society" was used for Badults.
ScriptEditor(andrewCollins, badults) ::: Andrew Collins was the script editor for Badults.
Conclusion:
ScriptEditor(andrewCollins, series(workingTitle(secretDudeSociety))) ::: Andrew Collins was the script editor for a series with the working title "The Secret Dude Society".
